items: 【Android 15 Tablet】 The CP10 Pro ipad tablet is powered by the latest Android 15 OS with AI, ensuring broader app compatibility, faster startup times, and improved responsiveness. The new system provides a more personalized and safer experience,upgraded privacy protection and security.

【8GB RAM+32GB ROM Tablet】 This 10.1-inch tablet is equipped with 8GB (3GB fixed memory + 5GB virtual memory) RAM and 32GB ROM of large storage space, supporting a maximum expansion of 1TB (Micro SD Card). Has faster reaction speed and multitasking. The tablet has passed Google's GMS certification, and you can obtain various mainstream applications from the Google Store, such as Twitter, TikTok, Line, Instagram and more.

【High Performance Tablet】 The android 15 tablet adopts the latest 4-core CPU technology, with strong performance and low power consumption. The speed reaches 1.8Ghz. Ensure faster opening speed and smoother loading speed. Other features: Supports 2.4GHz and 5GHz WIFI, Bluetooth 5.0, 1280*800 high-definition screen, and more. Tablet use 5V2A Charger, Type-C Cable, you can charge the tablet fast.

【2+8MP HD Cameras & 6000mAh Big Capacity】 Our tablet adopts high-definition dual cameras, with a front 2MP and a rear 8MP. Photography, video recording, and video conferencing provide you with a smoother and clearer experience. In addition, the tablet is also equipped with a super large 6000mAh battery. Can ensure use for over 6-8 hours. Home entertainment and travel are both good choices, and you can take it anywhere.

【Best Gift Choice】 Tablets are lightweight and portable, tablet with keyboard mouse case stylus included. It can effectively protect and stand the tablet well. Exquisite appearance and extremely high configuration. High end and luxurious, this tablet suitable for various gift occasions.
